displayName: Nordic Lapland — Public Evidence Research Envelope
purpose: Traceable research-only demonstration of how public architecture-class and facility-existence evidence can be attached to the dependency model for a Finnish Lapland dual-path research envelope — without inventing customer-serving paths or end-to-end independence.
researchConclusion: Public sources support selected constellation architecture classes and named Nordic-relevant facility / PoP existence claims. Finnish Lapland site-to-gateway routing, shared backhaul, shared power, shared control, and end-to-end path independence remain UNKNOWN.

scope.label: Finnish Lapland dual-path research envelope (public evidence only)
scope.geographicNote: Envelope geography is Finnish Lapland / high-latitude Nordic research context. No fictional industrial site pin, terminal IDs, or invented gateways. Named facilities outside Lapland are facility-existence entities only — not serving-path edges.

temporalValidity.note: Retrieval date 2026-11-26. Historical Iridium ground-station list is from 2019-03-28 and must not be silently treated as a current inventory. OneWeb SNP compilation is as of May 2025.

catalogueClassification.note: Catalogue-based orbit mix is true because LEO broadband + LEO narrowband appear together. That boolean is not infrastructure independence.

evidence.title: GRYPS Advisor / indexed provider catalogue
evidence.claim: Starlink, OneWeb, and Iridium are distinct catalogue ids with LEO broadband / broadband / narrowband labels; catalogue-based orbit mix is true for this set in Model v0.4.
evidence.limitations: Catalogue metadata only — not gateway, backhaul, or site independence.
evidence.relevantPassage: ADVISOR_PROVIDERS / INDEXED_PROVIDERS catalogue ids and orbit/class fields.

evidence.title: Starlink Technology — optical ISL mesh
evidence.claim: Starlink publishes optical inter-satellite links (space lasers) forming a constellation mesh as an architecture class.
evidence.limitations: Not a named Nordic gateway map; not dual-path independence with OneWeb or Iridium.
evidence.relevantPassage: Each Starlink satellite contains 3 space lasers (Optical Intersatellite Links or ISLs) operating at up to 200 Gbps, which together across the constellation form a global internet mesh…

evidence.title: Starlink Progress 2025 — gateway sites vs Points-of-Presence
evidence.claim: Starlink’s published resilience narrative distinguishes multiple gateway sites from internet Points-of-Presence as separate routing elements.
evidence.limitations: Does not name Nordic facilities; must not invent Lapland gateways from this distinction.
evidence.relevantPassage: …multiple gateway sites and internet Points of-Presence locations for the constellation to route data through.

evidence.title: Iridium Network — cross-linked LEO mesh
evidence.claim: Iridium publishes a LEO constellation with each satellite cross-linked to four others, with polar coverage narrative.
evidence.limitations: Does not inventory current ground stations; does not bind Lapland terminals.
evidence.relevantPassage: In space, each satellite is cross-linked to four others… The Iridium constellation is in Low-Earth Orbit (LEO), approximately 780 kilometers…

evidence.title: Iridium IR — commercial ground stations including Svalbard (2019)
evidence.claim: As of 2019-03-28 Iridium stated that Svalbard, Norway was among its operational commercial ground stations (with Fairbanks and Tempe).

scope.label: Named commercial ground stations as of 2019-03-28
scope.geographicNote: Svalbard named; not a Lapland edge

evidence.limitations: Historical. Not silently current. Not a customer-serving path for Lapland. Do not conflate with OneWeb SNP at Svalbard.
evidence.relevantPassage: The Punta Arenas site now joins existing operational Iridium commercial ground stations in Fairbanks, Alaska; Svalbard, Norway and Tempe, Arizona.

evidence.title: IMO MSC.1/Circ.1613/Rev.2 — Iridium teleport vs gateway roles
evidence.claim: Iridium GMDSS documentation defines teleport and gateway as distinct terrestrial roles and describes cross-linked satellites.
evidence.limitations: Role taxonomy — not a Nordic facility inventory or Lapland path.
evidence.relevantPassage: Teleport means a terrestrial part of the Iridium mobile-satellite system which communicates between the Iridium satellites and the gateway… Gateway means a terrestrial part of a mobile satellite system that acts as an interface between the network and other communication networks.

evidence.title: TMA 2025 — OneWeb Phase 1 without ISLs
evidence.claim: Secondary technical study states current OneWeb Phase 1 satellites do not utilize ISLs, making SNP placement critical for coverage.

scope.label: OneWeb Phase 1 architecture class (as of paper)

evidence.limitations: Secondary; cites prior filings. Not Lapland performance. Not independence proof.
evidence.relevantPassage: Since the current OneWeb Phase 1 satellites do not utilize ISLs [18], [21], the strategic positioning of SNPs worldwide is crucial to achieve optimal coverage.

evidence.title: TMA 2025 Appendix — OneWeb Nordic SNPs (May 2025)
evidence.claim: Secondary compilation lists OneWeb SNPs including Svalbard (Norway), Piteå (Sweden), and Nuuk (Greenland) as of May 2025.

scope.geographicNote: Nordic/Arctic rows only; not Finnish Lapland serving paths

evidence.limitations: Compiled from AWS dataset + regulators per paper — not OneWeb primary attestation. Ages after May 2025. SNP ≠ PoP. Must not connect env-lapland to these SNPs without direct evidence.
evidence.relevantPassage: APPENDIX ONEWEB SNPS (MAY 2025) … Europe … Norway Svalbard … Sweden Piteå … Greenland Nuuk

evidence.title: Traficom — earth station licensing guidelines (1 Nov 2023)
evidence.claim: Finland requires a licence to establish and operate an earth station (conventional satellite terminal use generally outside that Act’s scope).
evidence.limitations: Context only — no facility inventory. Not attached to any connects_through edge.
evidence.relevantPassage: A licence … is required for the establishment and operation of an earth station and radar in Finnish territory… The scope of application of the Act does not cover the conventional use of satellite services.

evidence.title: Traficom — earth station register privacy notice
evidence.claim: Traficom maintains a licence/supervision register including earth-station location for official duties; this pack treats bulk public inventory as unavailable.
evidence.limitations: Explains UNKNOWN Finnish gateway inventory. Do not attempt unauthorized access.
evidence.relevantPassage: Register of licence and supervision matters related to earth station and radar operations … Location of the earth station or radar

That Traficom licensing proves or disproves gateway locations
Operational availability, latency, or performance for Lapland
Any Resilience Signature, grade, weight, or failure probability derived from this pack
That historical 2019 ground-station lists are verified current without re-check
